originalObjects.name: Acrobat
originalObjects.description: You become more nimble and agile.
originalObjects.effect: You gain proficiency in the Acrobatics skill. If you are already proficient, you add double your proficiency bonus to Acrobatics checks.

originalObjects.name: Acrobatic
originalObjects.description: You are exceptionally agile.
originalObjects.effect: You gain proficiency in Acrobatics and can use Dexterity instead of Strength for Athletics checks involving jumping.

originalObjects.name: Alert
originalObjects.description: Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits:
originalObjects.effect: +5 bonus to initiative, can't be surprised while conscious, creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls from being hidden

originalObjects.name: Alertness
originalObjects.description: You have finely tuned senses.
originalObjects.effect: +2 bonus to Perception checks and initiative rolls.

originalObjects.name: Improved Alertness
originalObjects.description: Your senses are incredibly sharp.
originalObjects.effect: You gain blindsense 10 feet and cannot be surprised while conscious.

originalObjects.name: Blind Fight
originalObjects.description: You can fight without relying on sight.
originalObjects.effect: You don't suffer disadvantage on attack rolls due to being blinded, and you can pinpoint the location of creatures within 30 feet.

originalObjects.name: Blind Fighting
originalObjects.description: You can fight effectively without sight.
originalObjects.effect: You have blindsight with a range of 10 feet. You can effectively see anything within this range that isn't behind total cover.

nameRelatedCandidates.reason: Manual name-related candidate only; requires reading every source and a notebook decision before alias/stacking changes

originalObjects.name: Athlete
originalObjects.description: You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits:
originalObjects.effect: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1, climbing doesn't cost extra movement, running long jump distance increases by feet equal to Strength modifier

originalObjects.name: Athletic Prodigy
originalObjects.description: Your physical prowess is exceptional.
originalObjects.effect: You gain proficiency in Athletics and Acrobatics. If already proficient, you add double your proficiency bonus.

originalObjects.name: Improved Athlete
originalObjects.description: Your athletic abilities are exceptional.
originalObjects.effect: Your climbing and swimming speeds equal your walking speed, and you can long jump your full Strength score.

originalObjects.name: Climber
originalObjects.description: You are an expert at scaling walls and cliffs.
originalObjects.effect: You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed and advantage on Athletics checks made to climb.

originalObjects.name: Improved Climber
originalObjects.description: You are an exceptional climber.
originalObjects.effect: You can climb on ceilings and overhangs, and you don't fall when you fail a climbing check by 4 or less.

originalObjects.name: Martial Adept
originalObjects.description: You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat maneuvers.
originalObjects.effect: Learn two maneuvers from the Battle Master archetype, gain one superiority die (d6)

originalObjects.name: Martial Adept (Advanced)
originalObjects.description: You have advanced martial training.
originalObjects.effect: You learn two additional maneuvers and gain one more superiority die.

originalObjects.name: Weapon Focus
originalObjects.description: You have specialized training with a particular weapon type.
originalObjects.effect: +1 to attack rolls with chosen weapon type

originalObjects.name: Weapon Master
originalObjects.description: You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons.
originalObjects.effect: You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice and increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1.

originalObjects.name: Jack of All Trades
originalObjects.description: Intelligence 12+ opens the listed two untrained skill slots.
originalObjects.effect: Choose two skills in which you lack proficiency. Add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to checks using those skills.
originalObjects.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

originalObjects.name: Prodigy
originalObjects.description: You have exceptional talent in multiple areas.
originalObjects.effect: You gain one skill proficiency, one tool proficiency, fluency in one language, and expertise in one skill.

originalObjects.name: Skill Expert
originalObjects.description: You have honed your proficiency with particular skills.
originalObjects.effect: You gain proficiency in one skill and expertise in one skill you're proficient with.

originalObjects.name: Skilled
originalObjects.description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.
originalObjects.effect: Gain proficiency in three skills or tools

originalObjects.name: Durable
originalObjects.description: Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits:
originalObjects.effect: Increase Constitution by 1, when you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, minimum amount regained equals twice your Constitution modifier

originalObjects.name: Hardy
originalObjects.description: You are resistant to environmental hazards.
originalObjects.effect: You have resistance to cold and heat damage, and you have advantage on saves against disease and poison.

originalObjects.name: Tenacity
originalObjects.description: Level 4 supports the listed +1 HP per level.
originalObjects.effect: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 for each character level, including levels already gained.
originalObjects.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

originalObjects.name: Tough
originalObjects.description: Your hit point maximum increases.
originalObjects.effect: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat.

originalObjects.name: Tough as Nails
originalObjects.description: Level 5 supports the listed +10% maximum HP.
originalObjects.effect: Your hit point maximum increases by 2 per character level when you take this feat, and by 2 whenever you gain a level thereafter.
originalObjects.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

originalObjects.name: Commanding Presence
originalObjects.description: You naturally command respect.
originalObjects.effect: You can use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength for Intimidation checks, and you have advantage on Persuasion checks against creatures of lower level.

originalObjects.name: Inspiring Leader
originalObjects.description: You can inspire others through stirring words.
originalObjects.effect: You can spend 10 minutes inspiring your companions, giving them temporary hit points.

originalObjects.name: Inspiring Presence
originalObjects.description: After a critical hit, Charisma 14+ inspires allies with the listed damage increase for 10 seconds.
originalObjects.effect: When you score a critical hit, allies within 30 feet who can see or hear you gain +1 to attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
originalObjects.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

originalObjects.name: Leadership
originalObjects.description: You inspire others to follow you.
originalObjects.effect: You can recruit followers and hirelings more easily, and they are more loyal to you.

originalObjects.name: Natural Leader
originalObjects.description: A Charisma 13+ leader steadies nearby allies with the feat's listed +1 morale.
originalObjects.effect: Allies within 10 feet who can hear you gain +1 on morale and fear saves while you are conscious.
originalObjects.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.
